Rule-of-Three: a new named table (a distinct abstraction from the overlay table) with only 2 consumers does not meet the >=3 call-site threshold for introducing the abstraction.

Alternative: both leaf criteria could be added as named guards in the existing route_criteria gate block without a dedicated table, or the plan could explicitly name a third pending leaf criterion to justify the table.
findings.finding: _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES is a new parallel routing table introduced for exactly 2 leaf criteria (removal-rationale, asserted-capability) with no third leaf criterion named in the current done-definition, failing the Rule-of-Three for the new abstraction itself.
